title: Use a storyboard-first workflow: generate storyboard frames with GPT-Image-2…
content: Use a storyboard-first workflow: generate storyboard frames with GPT-Image-2, arrange/refine them on an infinite Figma-like canvas, then convert the storyboard into cinematic video using Seedance 2.0.

Genera fotogramas de storyboard con GPT-image-2, organiza y refina escenas en un lienzo similar a Figma, colabora con un agente de IA, luego convierte el storyboard en video con Seedance 2.0.
